comment: Suggestion chips above an empty chat composer (DESIGN §h.6). Evaluated in the human's session against local facts from omanix-chat-facts, never by the agent; at most four show, in this order. `when` is one of overlay, failedUnit, updatePending, rolledBack, newDevice, firstDays. {area} {unit} {device} {agent} are filled from the fact and the resident's name. `chip` is the button, `text` what it puts in the composer (unsent).

rules.chip: What went wrong with my last change?
rules.text: What went wrong with my last change? It was rolled back.
What's in the update that's waiting for me?
What can I change on this computer?
